summary: Lead list data is richly structured with comprehensive metadata. Each provider record includes: name, slug, address, postcode, region, local authority, coordinates, phone, website, CQC rating + 5 sub-ratings, service types, specialisms, beds, last inspection date, inspection report URL, ownership type, registration date, meta title, meta description. The service taxonomy test verifies categorization. The quality report shows field completeness >99% for critical fields. The directory filters test verifies search/filter accuracy. Validation report (validation_report.json) confirms data quality with specific issue tracking.
assertions: Provider records contain 20+ structured fields with >99% completeness for critical fields
Quality report with per-field completeness and issue tracking
